mechanism: Both agents cause significant renal impairment and electrolyte derangements (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia); bumetanide-induced volume depletion and renal hypoperfusion potentiate zoledronic acid nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and hydration status closely; ensure adequate IV hydration before zoledronic acid infusion; consider alternative diuretic or bisphosphonate therapy; maintain serum creatinine baseline and avoid concurrent use if possible.
